l1.approach: 평가 때 드물고 배포 때 흔한 잠재 조건 정책으로 정식화하고, Le Cam 방법, 해시 기반 트리거, 트랩도어 가정으로 하한을 증명
l1.evaluation: 수동, 적응형 평가자의 오차 하한과 계산적 분리, 화이트박스 탐침의 표본 복잡도를 이론으로 도출

l2.gap: Safety testing assumes test behavior predicts deployment behavior, which may fail for context-dependent models.
l2.approach: Formalize models with hidden triggers rare in testing and prove limits for black-box evaluators.
l2.evaluation: Derive error lower bounds for each evaluator type and sample bounds for white-box access.
l2.query_text: If a model behaves unsafely only under conditions that are rare during testing but common in deployment, what is the fundamental limit on how well any black-box evaluator can estimate deployment risk, and when is more than black-box access mathematically necessary?
